design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (referral_and_authorization_management). Frozen 2026-09-24 14:40:00 EDT. Revision round 2 (policy-task audit r1 closed; see [Revision log]).

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 4]}. Tree (fan-out): root referral_ext_extension_visits (5 factors) <- referral_ext_oon_visit_share (4 factors, owner=user tool sign_oon_cost_share_acknowledgement_95eb7797) and <- referral_ext_visit_validity (4 factors, tool lengthen_referral_validity_fab859e3). Task 0 holds the imaging site change and the validity-only study extension; this task claims the out-of-network acknowledgement, the lengthening of visit referrals and the extension visit grant (grant_extension_visits_d2c34b29). With it all five extended policies are claimed. Known compromise: referral_requests has no amount column, so the signed per-visit share lives in the acknowledgement's reference and receipt.

[Why this is a good test] The patient asks only for more visits with her outside rheumatologist. The visit-extension rule carries two prerequisite sentences: a negated one ("Extension visits on an out-of-network referral are not posted until a cost-share acknowledgement signed by the patient within the past month stands on the referral.") and an affirmative one ("The extension visits are fixed only after the referral's valid-through date lies at least the tier's extension validity days beyond the handling date."). The records show the only acknowledgement was signed 2026-07-01 and valid_through 2026-10-17 is 23 days away. The agent finds the acknowledgement rule (the patient's own signature, carrying a per-visit share from four ladders over the billing class, account and ledger), hands it over, lengthens validity (four ladders incl. a status-dependent anchor), then sizes the visits (five ladders over the unit ledger, the lengthened date and the appointment fee ledger).

[Problem-tree card] Edge 1: root -> referral_ext_oon_visit_share, value_input, gate recent_signed_ack, form state, negated ('not posted until'); condition: a patient_signed oon_acknowledgement row created within the month before the handling date; false at the opening: initial_state.referral_requests.e5b2dd61-77b3-42cf-aa46-f888f3f6e25b.created_at = 2026-07-01T11:20:00-04:00; only the acknowledgement tool creates such rows. Edge 2: root -> referral_ext_visit_validity, value_input, gate visit_days_left, form state, affirmative ('fixed only after'); condition valid_through - handling date >= the tier's extension_validity_days (60); false at the opening: initial_state.referrals.2f50d295-d2c2-4edf-a5a1-0984e55660c5.valid_through = 2026-10-17 (23 days); for a visit referral only the lengthening moves valid_through, and the active-course span (extension_validity_days + 24, from the handling date) always reaches the waited-on state for every visit tier. The acknowledgement rule no longer carries any ordering sentence, so the two prerequisites are unordered and commute (same hash both orders). Deletion sensitivity: without the acknowledgement 0 visits; without the lengthening 2.

[Base-invariant card] All three writes have subject referral_validity_extended: extendable_status (exhausted) and under_extension_cap (0 < 1; only the grant increments it). Declared overrides: referral_validity_extension 'Each extension adds extension_validity_days ... (...)' on the lengthening and on the grant; referral_unit_accounting 'An initial or appeal approval grants the tier's units_per_approval, an extension grants extension_units (none where that is 0), and a retroactive authorization grants exactly the units of the services it covers.' and 'Units are granted only when the referral status is approved.' on the grant (replaced by the computed visits and by 'An extension grant may be posted on an exhausted referral, which returns to approved with that grant.').

[Business-object card] Target: Out-of-Network Referral 2f50d295... (payer auth 3380571926, Dr. Miriam Castellanos, MD (Cleveland Clinic Department of Rheumatology)). Unit rows: grant a1af999a... (3); uses 4ef4f030... (07-28), ebc3b15b... (08-18), 7505ed74... (08-18 duplicate of ENC-32246603), cd9d6725... (09-08); restoration ea4ce512... of the duplicate: net 3 (near miss: 4 raw gives 5 visits). Old acknowledgement e5b2dd61... (near miss for the gate). Fees: no-show 2025-05-21 (waived, outside 12 months), no-show 2026-04-08, late-cancellation 2026-02-19. Billing: latest deductible charge 184.00 (2026-06-18), payment 244.00 (near miss if netted), balance 0.00; coverage verified 2026-06-26, exactly 90 days before the handling date (boundary near miss for two computations).

[Factor card — share, expected 129.00, whole-baseline 30.00] share_copay (parameter: PPO collects, specialist 60.00; baseline 30.00 -> 99.00). share_deductible_basis (parameter, multi-source: 184.00; -> 60.00). share_collection_rate (parameter, multi-source: 90 days is not older than the class's 90 -> class 50 percent; -> 60.00; careless 100 -> 198.00). share_hardship_relief (method: 25 percent, below 50 -> 92.00 x 0.75 = 69.00; -> 152.00).
[Factor card — lengthening, expected 65, whole-baseline 60] course_span (parameter: exhausted with a use inside two months -> 60 + 24 = 84; -> 39). course_anchor (method: exhausted -> 84 - 23 = 61; -> 86). course_recheck (parameter: 90 > 30 but not > 90 -> internal 2; -> 61; careless payer 5 -> 66). course_roll (parameter: 2026-12-19 is a Saturday -> 2 days; -> 63).
[Factor card — visits, expected 4, whole-baseline 2] carry_forward (method: net 3, last use 16 days -> 3; -> 3). window_adjustment (parameter: 88 days -> +1; -> 3). exhaustion_pace (parameter: 50 days -> +2; -> 2). no_show_trim (parameter: 1; -> 5). late_cancel_trim (parameter: 1; -> 5).

[Rule <-> compute] Every binding quotes its rule sentence; every ladder, the deductible cap, rounding, the windows (3 months, 30 days, 2 months, 12 months, one month), the anchor, the roll and the floor of one visit are claimed by a binding; all tier values are stated in the rules as numbers.

[Persona] Theresa volunteers only her need; identity on request; prepared answers (three visits since July, the fixed portal duplicate, insurance unchanged, one missed and one late-cancelled appointment, no amounts); a passive conditional covers the agent's explanation of the signature and the lengthening; she runs the handed tool and ends when told the visits are approved.

[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(DOB, SSN4) -> find_referrals -> find_referral_events -> find_referral_requests -> find_billing_accounts -> find_billing_transactions -> find_appointments -> find_appointment_events -> patient signs 129.00 -> lengthen 65 -> grant 4.

[Verification run] check_compute's evaluator on the handling-time worlds: share 129.00 (99/60/60/152, all 30); lengthening 65 (39/86/61/63, all 60); visits 4 after both prerequisites (3/3/2/5/5, all 2); 0 without the acknowledgement, 2 without the lengthening; both orders replay to one hash.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the rules, tool schemas, persona and finder returns alone: the two prerequisite sentences against the old acknowledgement and the 23-day validity force the acknowledgement and the lengthening; the rules give 129.00, 65 and 4. Agrees with gold.

[Revision log — round 2, from audits/policy_task r1]
- F-1: referral_ext_extension_visits now declares the superseded referral_unit_accounting sentence on extension units (and, for O-13, the approved-only grant sentence).
- F-2: the acknowledgement rule no longer says 'Before an Out-of-Network Referral is extended'; it only states what the acknowledgement carries, so no undeclared order or second wording remains.
- F-3 / finding 2(a): course_roll relabelled parameter (2 days / 1 day / none); visit_validity keeps 4 honest factors.
- Finding 2(b): coverage verification moved to 2026-06-26 (exactly 90 days old), a boundary near miss for course_recheck (internal 2 vs payer 5 -> 66) and for share_collection_rate; the internal course allowance is 2 so the Saturday roll keeps 65; the deductible charge became 184.00 so no half-cent tie arises; share 198.75 -> 129.00.
- Finding 3: prerequisite_closure edge conditions are copied from the charter (edge 1 'within the month').
- O-1: the active-course span is now the tier's extension_validity_days plus 24, so the lengthening can always reach the waited-on state. O-2: tier values stated as numbers. O-3: open-course tier says 'approved and still has units remaining'. O-4: the lengthening docstring no longer alludes to another write. O-6: edge effect generalised. O-11: waived fees count. O-T1-1: no_user_hint quotes the conditional line.
user_scenario: You are Theresa Mahoney, 57, a retired school librarian in Delaware, Ohio, calling Linden Ridge Patient Services in the afternoon. You are warm and chatty but a little anxious about paperwork, and you like the agent to explain things in plain words. Since July you have been seeing an outside rheumatologist, Dr. Miriam Castellanos at the Cleveland Clinic, because Linden Ridge could not see you soon enough, and your primary care doctor, Dr. Anil Kapoor, set up the referral. You open with: "Hello, this is Theresa Mahoney. I've used up all my visits with Dr. Castellanos at the Cleveland Clinic, and I need more visits approved so I can keep seeing her." You want to keep seeing Dr. Castellanos specifically and nobody else. You give identity details only when asked, one at a time: your phone number is 6145553762, your date of birth is November 2, 1968 (1968-11-02), and the last four digits of your Social Security number are 3409. You do not know any referral or authorization numbers. If asked how many times you have seen Dr. Castellanos, you say three times since July, and that the portal once showed your August visit twice but someone fixed it. If asked whether your insurance has changed, you say no, still the same Anthem plan through your husband's retirement coverage since January. If asked about missed appointments, you admit you missed one appointment with Dr. Kapoor in the spring and had to cancel a rheumatology visit at the last minute in February, and you paid those fees. You do not know your deductible or any amounts and you ask the agent to go by the records. You know nothing about how referrals are handled. If the agent says something has to be signed by you or lengthened on the referral before the new visits can be added, you ask what it means for you, and once it is explained you agree. When the agent hands you a step to complete yourself, you do it exactly as the agent describes, with the details the agent gives you, and read back what it shows. You never suggest numbers or steps of your own and never correct the agent. Once the agent tells you the new visits are approved and how many, you thank them warmly, say that is everything, and end the call.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel and commute: the acknowledgement writes only a referral_requests row that the validity computation never reads, and the lengthening writes only valid_through that the share computation never reads. Replaying acknowledgement->lengthening->visits and lengthening->acknowledgement->visits with the real tools gives the same terminal hash (3a393ced8a579ca9...), and every scored value is unchanged (129.00, 65, 4). No rule orders the two.
